# Yordan Hristov — Senior Product Designer

> I build AI-ready design systems with 1:1 code parity and architect the AI workflows that connect product, design, and engineering. Working alongside Technical Product Managers and developers, I close the traditional handoff: designing the systems, optimising the processes, and contributing directly to PRDs, prototypes, and production code.

## Profile

- Location: Sofia, Bulgaria
- Availability: Open to new projects
- Email: yhristov.xyz@gmail.com

I build AI-ready design systems: component libraries with 1:1 parity between Figma and code, plus custom Claude skills and MCP setups that let agents assemble UI from the real system without drift. I write and ship the frontend myself, reviewed and merged by engineering. Under the tooling sits seven years of research practice: user interviews, usability testing, and WCAG 2.1 AA auditing.

## Case studies

### 01 · This site — Portfolio as a Product

A portfolio built as a product: repo-first design system, compiled copy, an MCP server and a chat assistant answering from one corpus, and a published retrieval evaluation. Open source, no build step in the site.

Tags: Designer & Builder, Design system, AI-first, MCP server, Storybook, Figma push, Open source
Metrics: 0 accessibility violations

### 02 · Green Street — AI-ready design systems and Agentic workflows

Green Street's first design system, and the steps that took it from a Figma library into production: a shipped navigation component, an AI prototype pipeline for the TPM team, and a product module rebuilt at 1:1 Figma parity with 100% token coverage.

Tags: Senior Product Designer, Design Systems, AI Workflows, Figma-to-code, WCAG, Production code

### 03 · Green Street — UX & Accessibility Audits

UX and WCAG 2.1 AA audits of two product surfaces: an editorial platform and a data-dense analytics platform. 200+ issue instances covering accessibility, consistency, visual hierarchy, and UI patterns, ordered into a remediation roadmap.

Tags: Senior Product Designer, Accessibility, UX Audit, WCAG 2.1 AA, Two products
Metrics: 200+ Issue instances catalogued

### 04 · Domestina.bg — Cleaning Service Marketplace

Multi-year, research-led UX on Bulgaria's leading cleaning marketplace. Front page, flows, onboarding, loyalty: bounce rate down 40%, retention up.

Tags: UX Researcher & Designer, UX Research, Data-driven, Marketplace, Multi-year
Metrics: −40% reduction in front page bounce rate

### 05 · Municipality of Malko Tarnovo — Municipal Mobile App

Civic app serving tourists and older residents at once. White-label token system. Live on the App Store and Google Play.

Tags: Product Designer, Shipped, Design System, iOS & Android, White-label, Accessibility

## Other projects

- **Mindromeda** (Marketplace · shipped) — Connecting people to licensed therapists and coaches. Full design and IA: matching by need, booking, corporate vouchers. Live on Google Play.
- **Tax Advice — USD Accounts** (Fintech · cross-border) — The USD bank account feature for a cross-border tax refund service, designed end to end from proposition to launch.
- **Painted Auto Parts** (Internal order system) — Complex order and project management UI for a top US auto parts distributor.
- **Go Guide App** (Consumer mobile app) — First-ever mobile app for Bulgaria's leading lifestyle media brand. Shipped.
- **Payment / Crypto / Stocks** (Fintech · concept) — A self-initiated concept, not client work: one IA unifying crypto, fiat and stock trading. 50+ Figma components and variants.
- **Paraflow** (Corporate website) — Fully custom site and design system for a leading enterprise IT integrator, on a Laravel CMS.
- **Generative Art Platform** (NFT / Web3 · concept) — A concept study, not client work: an artist discovery platform for the NFT community, designed full scope from IA to UI.

## Experience

### Senior Product Designer — Green Street (commercial real estate data and analytics)

Jan 2026 – Present · Sofia · Hybrid

- Built the company's first design system: a two-level token architecture with full colour ramps, and a complete base component library in Figma matching the shadcn/ui inventory.
- Rebuilt the AI Assistant module on design tokens through one agent-orchestrated PR: 35 components at 1:1 Figma parity, 100% token coverage in SCSS variables and mixins, functionality preserved, automated tests, and a styleguide rendering the real components.
- Shipped production frontend: designed and coded the platform's responsive navigation, reviewed by engineering and live.
- Built the TPM prototype pipeline: a component library and custom Claude skills that assemble interactive feature mocks matching production, removing the design bottleneck from stakeholder approvals.
- Audited two product surfaces against WCAG 2.1 AA and UX heuristics: 200+ issue instances catalogued with severity ratings into a prioritised remediation roadmap.
- Now building the contract-first, git-based design system: tokens, components and design rationales in the repository, verified in CI, every surface generated from one contract. This portfolio runs a personal version of the same architecture, open source.

### Senior Product Designer — Studio Kipo (sole designer for all client work)

2023 – Dec 2025 · Sofia · Remote

- Introduced design systems as studio practice. No client asked for one; I built a white-label token-based system and reused it across projects, cutting setup time on every new brief and giving developers one source for spacing, colour, and type.
- Ubistats Football. Analytics platform taken from research through design system, UI, and usability testing. Led to a partnership with the Bulgarian Football Union.
- Spetema. A 200+ product coffee catalogue serving households and businesses from one site: home and business tracks, a preparation-method finder over the category taxonomy, eight sub-brands on a shared attribute model. Bilingual, live.
- Mindromeda. Mental health marketplace connecting people to licensed therapists and coaches. Full design and IA: specialist matching by need, session booking, and consumer access alongside corporate vouchers. Live on Google Play.
- Malko Tarnovo Municipal App. Semantic colour tokens and a dual visual language serving tourists and older residents at once. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- Also: the USD bank account feature for Tax Advice, a cross-border tax refund service, designed end to end from proposition to launch; Go Guide, the first mobile app for Bulgaria's leading lifestyle media brand; and an internal order management UI for a top US auto parts distributor.

### UX Researcher & Consultant — Domestina (Bulgaria's leading cleaning services marketplace)

2019 – Present · advisory since 2022 · Sofia

- Rebuilt the front page and the critical booking flows after heuristic evaluation, user interviews, and Hotjar session analysis. Bounce rate dropped 40% and sessions ran longer.
- Shaped research-driven features including the Domestina Club loyalty programme and a rebuilt registration flow, supporting retention and the move beyond the local market.
- Still consulting on research and flow decisions.

### Product Designer & Frontend — Independent

2018 – Present · Remote

- NFT and crypto: launched solo and collaborative projects covering digital art, community mechanics, and gamification. Creative coding in p5.js and Three.js sold as digital art; market and competitor research produced profitable collections during a bear market.
- Design, frontend implementation, and QA for portfolio and small-business sites, working in a small team.

### Service Designer & Team Lead — Live to Lift

2009 – 2020 · Sofia

- Managed a team of 5–6 coaches. Designed the recruitment programme and trained every new hire into it.
- Built the assessment and interview framework the whole practice ran on: hundreds of client interviews, structured progress measurement, outcome tracking.
- Ran client surveys, analysed outcome and business data, and owned the online presence and camp programme.

### Quality Assurance Expert — CNCsys PLC (software QA with some test automation, first technical role)
